statement_changes: No statement changed in content. These hypotheses are not used by the proofs, the unused-variable linter warns on them (`clear h` does not count as a use), and the strict library's warningAsError would then reject the file at graduation. `_h` is the strict library's own convention (GX/BTZ/AbsMax.lean, GX/BTZ/Rigid.lean, GX/BTZ/LocalModel.lean). findings: colI_v1.tex l.876-877 (Misner): « If I is a component of l(p) minus (i+(l(p)) u i-(l(p))) » is false under the time-like reading of l.820 (OQ-116 (a), the file's reading). The two components are closed arcs, each containing light-like directions (GX.components_compl_ds, GX.exists_null_mem_of_mem_components_compl_ds). The developed image I is open and contains none of them. Proved: in the Misner case I is a component K minus its light-like directions (its two ends), I = K n {Q > 0}, and I != K for every component K (GX.GammaLinkCircle.IsLiftedDev.spacelike_degree_zero_misner). Under the causal reading the Misner bullet holds as printed but the two BTZ-like bullets (l.873, l.875, « I = i+-(l(p)) ») fail, since I is then the interior of the closed arc. This is argued, not formalized, and confirms OQ-116 (a): no reading makes l.873, l.875 and l.877 all literally true. Smallest correction: « I is the interior of a component ».

colI_v1.tex l.881-886 and l.889-891 (light-like, degree 0): « L is the quotient of i+(l(p)) or i-(l(p)) » with the printed i-(l(p)) at bdH2+ (l.828-833; the closed arc {B(p,.) >= 0}). The developed image is never that arc, because it contains the two tangent directions, which are fixed by the holonomy (GX.GammaLinkCircle.IsLiftedDev.null_degree_zero_ne; symmetrically i+(l(p)) at bdH2-). The image is i- minus the tangent directions (GX.GammaLinkCircle.IsLiftedDev.bdPlus_degree_zero, bdMinus_degree_zero). This is the correction OQ-116 (b) proposes; this closure adds the degree-0 instance.

colI_v1.tex l.794-800 (carried from T-bbs-hs-singularities, restated because isParabolic_of_null is now proved): « L is a hyperbolic / parabolic RP1-circle » needs non-trivial holonomy. The regular link has lifted holonomy delta^2, neither hyperbolic nor parabolic (GX.regular_not_isHyperbolic, GX.not_isParabolic_delta_sq). The Lean statements carry toPSL f != 1.
questions: I+- (l.898): « the preimage in L~_p of i+-(l(p)) by the developing map », with L~_p ≈ RP~1. Reading taken: I+- is read in RP~1, as linkCover^-1(i+-(l(p))). The identification L~_p ≈ RP~1 is D, which is onto in degree k >= 1, so this is D(d^-1(i+-)). GX.GammaLinkCircle.IsLiftedDev.iPlus_components states it this way (the statement is the previous closer's, unchanged). The alternative, d^-1(i+-) inside L~ = R through E, is its preimage under the homeomorphism D.

OQ-116 (a), carried. i+- at p in dS2 is read as the future (past) time-like directions. This decides the Misner bullet: see the first finding. Under the causal reading, spacelike_degree_zero's first two cases would fail as printed.

OQ-116 (b), carried. At bdH2+ the dS2 side is read without its tangent directions (i- minus T), the closed arc being impossible as a developed image (second finding). The ∂ℍ²₋ statement (new) uses the mirror reading, i+ minus T.

OQ-113 (d) and OQ-122 (a), carried. « Elliptic » includes central holonomy (time-like case: holonomy 1 or the half-turn). At a light-like p, every element != 1 of Gamma_p is parabolic (Gamma_p is the group of null rotations, not cyclic).
kb_proposals: The arc structure of l(p) at p in dS2, read on RP~1, is GX.arc_structure_of_deSitter. Let g lift A != 1 of Gamma_p and have a fixed point. Let a < b < a + 1 be consecutive fixed points with Fix(g) = a + Z u b + Z and ]a, b[ meeting i+. Then linkCover^-1 i+ = U_i ]a+2i, b+2i[ and linkCover^-1 i- = U_i ]a+2i+1, b+2i+1[, and ]b, a+1[ is space-like. Get a and b around any non-fixed t from GX.GTilde.IsHyperbolic.exists_consecutive.

To argue on one turn of l(p) (delta^2, period 2), reduce t into [a, a + 2) with GX.exists_linkCover_eq_Ico theta a t. Then split by GX.mem_Ico_two_cases into the four points a, b, a+1, b+1 and the four open intervals between them; linkCover (y + 1) = -linkCover y moves between the halves.

At a light-like p, the developed image of a degree-0 link is {B(p,.) < 0} or {B(p,.) > 0} (GX.GammaLinkCircle.IsLiftedDev.null_degree_zero). The 'onto' step is GX.image_Ioo_add_one_eq: an open half-turn ]a, a+1[ mapping into a set with no antipodal pair and containing neither end maps onto it.

i+-(L) = L or empty follows from the values of the developing map, by GX.GammaLinkCircle.IsLiftedDev.iPlusL_eq_univ / iPlusL_eq_empty (iMinus alike), through IsDevAlong.preimage_iPlus and E surjective.
The two components of l(p) minus (i+ u i-) at p in dS2 are named by GX.components_compl_ds: {Q >= 0, <j,.> >= 0} and {Q >= 0, <j,.> <= 0}. IPm's ncard_components_compl_ds only counts them.
